verdict.rationale: Brex ships its own AI agents for auditing, reviewing, and expense assistance, so letting users plug external MCP servers into those agents is a fair question for this product. The pack only documents an official Brex MCP server, which lets outside AI assistants call Brex. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Brex's agents connecting to or consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
